أنشغف (form VII)
# أَنْشَغِفُ (ʔanšaḡifu) /ʔan.ʃa.ɣi.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْشَغَفَ (inšaḡafa)
# أَنْشَغِفَ (ʔanšaḡifa) /ʔan.ʃa.ɣi.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْشَغَفَ (inšaḡafa)
# أَنْشَغِفْ (ʔanšaḡif) /ʔan.ʃa.ɣif/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْشَغَفَ (inšaḡafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
